node.title: Re: curl problem
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I don't think the translation of curl -u : to default_headers => { AUTH_ID=>..., AUTH_TOKEN=>... } is correct. In [man://curl], -u specifies a username/password for authentication, the equivalent in [mod://HTTP::Tiny] (and therefore [mod://HTTP::Tinyish], I assume) is to include a username:password in the URL - but it supports Basic Authentication only. See the [mod://HTTP::Tiny] docs for details, but if you have to support Digest Auth, you might need to switch to something like [mod://LWP].
